description: Cross-layer root-cause board of the MiniBank lab: one rule-based verdict (KQL function MiniBankRootCause in law-appmon) plus the signals of every layer. Variable 'verdict' = hide for a human-versus-board workshop.

panels.title: Verdict now (rule-based, last 6 minutes; MiniBankRootCause() in law-appmon; Pending = waiting for the slower layer data)

panels.description: Display only, it does not change the verdict or the scoring. After the board has given an answer (two RootCause readings in a row) and the newest reading is no longer that answer, this banner shows 'Recovering - last cause: X' for 10 minutes. In those minutes the 6-minute window still holds leftover errors or slow calls, so the live reading can briefly show Pending, Unclassified, Warning or the same layer again. Function MiniBankRecovering() in law-appmon, from the observer history MiniBankVerdict_CL. Hidden in workshop mode.
panels.title: Recovery banner (display only: 10 minutes after the last confirmed answer)

panels.description: The layer that explains the user impact: VM, OpenShift, Network, Application or Database. Healthy = no user impact and no layer signal. Pending = users are impacted and the board waits (about 2 minutes) for the slower VM, OpenShift, network and schema data before naming a layer. Unclassified = users are impacted but no rule matched: open Investigate (AI) on the alert.

No layer at fault.text: A few slow transactions, no layer at fault

panels.title: Verdict details (component, evidence, onset, impact)

panels.description: The monitored stack of the MiniBank lab, coloured live. RED = the layer the verdict names (only from MiniBankRootCause, rules unchanged). YELLOW = a signal or an affected part that is not the cause. BLUE = the first signal while the verdict is Pending (checking every layer). ORANGE bar = users impacted. GREY = no data. Lines = calls between services; a yellow line is slow or failing. Verdict = hide (mystery mode): no red or blue, signals only. Click a box to open its evidence panel. Query: MiniBankTopology($__timeTo(), verdict) in law-appmon. HOST box (bottom): true host CPU load from the hypervisor vs the host's Windows view, VMs waiting >= 3x their normal for a processor, and the VM using the most processors; RED only when the verdict names the Host layer (rule R9). VM and OpenShift node boxes turn yellow when they wait >= 3x.

Layer signals: Host, VM, OpenShift, network, application, database

panels.description: True host load = Hyper-V Hypervisor Logical Processor(_Total) % Total Run Time (every VM plus the host). The host's own Windows (Task Manager, Processor % Processor Time) only sees its root partition, so it stays low even when the VMs fight for CPU. The Azure metric Percentage CPU of the HV-HOST-02 VM is shown as a cross-check. BATCH-EOD = the end-of-day batch VM (fault card cpu-host).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Perf | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and Computer startswith 'HV-HOST-02' and InstanceName == '_Total'
| where (ObjectName == 'Hyper-V Hypervisor Logical Processor' and CounterName == '% Total Run Time') or (ObjectName == 'Processor' and CounterName == '% Processor Time')
| extend Series = iff(ObjectName == 'Processor', 'Windows on the host (Task Manager view) %', 'True host load (hypervisor, all VMs) %')
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Series
| order by TimeGenerated asc

Perf | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and Computer startswith 'HV-HOST-02' and ObjectName == 'Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor' and CounterName == '% Total Run Time' and InstanceName startswith 'BATCH-EOD:'
| summarize U = sum(CounterValue) / 100.0 by TimeGenerated
| summarize Value = avg(U) / 20.0 * 100.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| extend Series = 'BATCH-EOD share of the host %' | order by TimeGenerated asc

azureMonitor.alias: Azure metric Percentage CPU of the HV-HOST-02 VM %

panels.title: Host HV-HOST-02: true CPU load vs what Windows on the host shows

panels.description: Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch, averaged per VM. Normal is about 15-30 µs. During host CPU contention every VM waits several times longer (rule R9 needs >= 3x the previous hour for several VMs), while each VM's own CPU can look normal.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Perf | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and Computer startswith 'HV-HOST-02' and ObjectName == 'Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor' and CounterName == 'CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch' and InstanceName != '_Total'
| extend VM = tostring(split(InstanceName, ':')[0]) | where VM != 'BATCH-EOD'
| summarize Value = avg(CounterValue) / 1000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), VM
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Host HV-HOST-02: CPU wait per dispatch by VM (µs) - how long each VM waits for a processor

Mystery mode scorecard (answers recorded after the reveal; the verdict never reads them)

panels.description: How a slot is scored (approved 15 Nov 2026 - the same rules as the test grader): customers count as affected when two readings in a row show customer impact. If customers were affected, the board's first confirmed answer (two red readings in a row on one layer, or two host warnings in a row) must name the right layer within 5 minutes of the start, or within 2.5 minutes of customers being affected if that came later. If customers were not affected, that confirmed answer - or else the first layer shown twice in a row - must name the right layer within 5 minutes. A healthy slot passes when no confirmed answer appears from minute 4 until 3 minutes after the end.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Scorecard, approved grading (15 Nov 2026 22:35 WIB) - the same rules as the test grader:
// customers count as affected when two readings in a row show customer impact.
// Affected: the first confirmed answer (two red readings in a row on one layer, or two host warnings in a row) must name the
//   expected layer within 5 min of the start, or within 2.5 min of customers being affected if that came later.
// Not affected: that confirmed answer, or else the first layer shown twice in a row (yellow or red), must be the expected layer
//   within 5 min. Healthy slot: a confirmed answer from minute 4 to 3 min after the end is a false alarm.
let runs = MiniBankMystery_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and Result in ('revealed', 'series', 'labelled', 'void')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId, Slot
| extend Start = todatetime(StartUtc), End = todatetime(EndUtc);
let rd = MiniBankVerdict_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| project VT = TimeGenerated, VStatus = Status, VLayer = Layer | order by VT asc
| extend PrevLayer = prev(VLayer), PrevStatus = prev(VStatus), PrevT = prev(VT)
| extend Imp = VStatus in ('Pending', 'RootCause', 'Unclassified'), PrevImp = PrevStatus in ('Pending', 'RootCause', 'Unclassified')
| extend RedPair = VStatus in ('RootCause', 'Unclassified') and PrevStatus in ('RootCause', 'Unclassified') and PrevLayer == VLayer,
         HostPair = VLayer == 'Host' and PrevLayer == 'Host' and VStatus in ('Warning', 'RootCause') and PrevStatus in ('Warning', 'RootCause'),
         ShownPair = VStatus in ('Warning', 'RootCause') and PrevStatus in ('Warning', 'RootCause') and PrevLayer == VLayer
                     and VLayer !in ('', 'Healthy', 'Pending', 'No layer at fault', 'Unclassified'),
         ImpPair = Imp and PrevImp
| extend Key = bin(VT, 1m);
let win = runs | where Result != 'void'
| extend WStart = iff(ExpectedLayer == 'Healthy', Start + 4m, Start), WEnd = End + 3m
| mv-expand Key = range(bin(WStart, 1m), bin(WEnd, 1m), 1m) to typeof(datetime)
| project RunId, Slot, Start, WStart, WEnd, Key;
let w = rd | join kind=inner win on Key | where VT between (WStart .. WEnd);
let st = w | summarize AffT = minif(iff(PrevT < Start, Start, PrevT), ImpPair) by RunId, Slot;
let conf = w | where RedPair or HostPair | summarize arg_min(VT, VLayer, VStatus) by RunId, Slot | project RunId, Slot, OT = VT, OLayer = VLayer, OStatus = VStatus;
let shown = w | where ShownPair | summarize arg_min(VT, VLayer, VStatus) by RunId, Slot | project RunId, Slot, YT = VT, YLayer = VLayer, YStatus = VStatus;
runs
| join kind=leftouter st on RunId, Slot | join kind=leftouter conf on RunId, Slot | join kind=leftouter shown on RunId, Slot
| extend Affected = isnotnull(AffT)
| extend UseYel = isnull(OT) and not(Affected) and isnotnull(YT)
| extend AT = iff(isnotnull(OT), OT, iff(UseYel, YT, datetime(null))), ALayer = iff(isnotnull(OT), OLayer, iff(UseYel, YLayer, '')),
         AStatus = iff(isnotnull(OT), OStatus, iff(UseYel, YStatus, ''))
| extend MinutesToVerdict = iff(isnull(AT), real(null), round((AT - Start) / 1m, 1)), ImpMin = iff(Affected, round((AffT - Start) / 1m, 1), real(null))
| extend DueMin = iff(Affected, max_of(5.0, ImpMin + 2.5), 5.0)
| extend AnswerType = case(isnull(AT), '', AStatus == 'Warning', 'Warning (yellow)', AStatus == 'RootCause', 'Root cause (red)', AStatus)
| extend Customers = case(Result == 'void' or ExpectedLayer == 'Healthy', '', Affected, strcat('affected from ', tostring(ImpMin), ' min'), 'not affected')
| extend Verdict = case(Result == 'void', 'VOID (fault did not start)',
                        ExpectedLayer == 'Healthy' and isnull(OT), 'OK: no false alarm',
                        ExpectedLayer == 'Healthy', strcat('FALSE ALARM: ', OLayer),
                        isnull(AT) and Affected, 'NO VERDICT - customers affected, no confirmed answer',
                        isnull(AT), 'NO VERDICT - no layer shown twice in a row',
                        ALayer != ExpectedLayer, strcat('WRONG LAYER: ', ALayer),
                        MinutesToVerdict > DueMin, 'RIGHT LAYER (late)',
                        UseYel, 'RIGHT LAYER - early warning, customers not affected',
                        AStatus == 'Warning', 'RIGHT LAYER - early warning',
                        'RIGHT LAYER')
| project StartWIB = format_datetime(Start + 7h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), RunId, Mode, Slot, Number, Card, ExpectedLayer, BoardLayer = ALayer, AnswerType, MinutesToVerdict, Customers, Verdict
| order by StartWIB desc, Slot asc
